description: Teaching taxonomy for open-source tools in Digital Engineering and Systems Engineering. DRAFT for lecturer review: rename, merge or add entries freely; ids are what the LLM returns, labels are what students see.

categories.label: MBSE, requirements & architecture
categories.description: Model-based systems engineering, requirements management, system architecture and trade studies.

subcategories.label: Trade studies, decision analysis & optimisation of system concepts
Safety, reliability & risk analysis (FMEA, FTA, STPA)
Parametric / GUI CAD (FreeCAD, Onshape add-ons, SolidWorks tools)
CAD data exchange (STEP, IFC, glTF, USD)

categories.label: Real-time 3D, game engines & XR
categories.description: Interactive visualisation of engineering systems on the web, in game engines and in XR.

subcategories.label: Game engines & engine plugins (Unreal, Unity, Godot)

categories.label: 3D content creation & automation
categories.description: Producing 3D assets and scenes, increasingly with scripting and AI.

categories.label: Reality capture, geospatial & built environment
categories.description: Capturing and modelling the physical world: scans, maps, buildings and infrastructure.

categories.label: Robotics & autonomous systems
categories.description: Software for robots, drones and autonomous vehicles.

categories.label: IoT, data & digital twin platforms
categories.description: Connecting physical assets to data, the backbone of operational digital twins.

subcategories.label: Industrial protocols & connectivity (OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus)

categories.label: Embedded systems & electronics
categories.description: Hardware design and the software that runs on it.

categories.label: AI for engineering
categories.description: AI models and agents applied to engineering work.

subcategories.label: Agents & MCP servers that drive engineering software
ML models & datasets for engineering data
General AI developer tools (coding assistants, LLM frameworks)

categories.label: General software (not engineering-specific)
categories.description: Use when the tool has no specific engineering application. Lets the pipeline flag noise from broad crawl seeds.

lifecycle_phases.label: Concept & requirements
lifecycle_phases.description: Stakeholder needs, requirements, concept of operations (left top of the V).

lifecycle_phases.label: Detailed design
lifecycle_phases.description: CAD, electronics design, software design of components.

lifecycle_phases.label: Analysis & simulation
lifecycle_phases.description: Virtual testing and performance prediction before building.

lifecycle_phases.label: Implementation & integration
lifecycle_phases.description: Building, coding, manufacturing, assembling and integrating subsystems (bottom/right of the V).

lifecycle_phases.label: Verification & validation
lifecycle_phases.description: Testing against requirements: HIL/SIL, test automation, V&V of models.

lifecycle_phases.label: Operations & sustainment
lifecycle_phases.description: Monitoring, maintenance, operational digital twins, end of life.

lifecycle_phases.label: Visualisation & communication (cross-cutting)
lifecycle_phases.description: Communicating designs and data to stakeholders across all phases.

trl_scale.label: Idea / paper code
trl_scale.evidence: Concept, paper companion or notebook; may not run.

trl_scale.label: Proof of concept
trl_scale.evidence: Runs a narrow demo for the author; little or no documentation.

trl_scale.label: Experimental prototype
trl_scale.evidence: Demonstrates the core idea; frequent breaking changes; setup is fragile.

trl_scale.label: Early alpha
trl_scale.evidence: Others can install it with effort; basic README; few releases; small user base.

trl_scale.label: Alpha in use
trl_scale.evidence: Used by early adopters; examples exist; API still changing.

trl_scale.label: Beta
trl_scale.evidence: Versioned releases, docs and install instructions; issues get answered; active community.

trl_scale.label: Production-ready
trl_scale.evidence: Stable releases, good docs, used in real projects or by companies.

trl_scale.label: Mature & widely adopted
trl_scale.evidence: Large community, long track record, stable API, ecosystem of plugins/integrations.

trl_scale.label: Industry standard
trl_scale.evidence: De-facto standard in its field (e.g. Blender, ROS 2, OpenFOAM, QGIS).

teaching_uses.label: Awareness only (too immature or too niche to use in class)
